scenarios.name: normal_occupied

scenarios.name: normal_unoccupied
scenarios.description: Reference vector: fan off while unoccupied

scenarios.description: Reference vector: fan on, unoccupied, no override; alarms after grace_period (1800 s) + alarm_delay (900 s)
